description:
Driver Position at the Embassy of Montenegro in Bucharest

The Embassy of Montenegro in Bucharest is seeking a reliable and experienced Driver to join our team. As a Driver at the Embassy, you will have the opportunity to play a crucial role in supporting the daily operations of the Embassy and its staff.

  • Responsibilities:
    • Transport Embassy staff, guests, and officials safely and efficiently to various locations.
    • Run errands, such as picking up supplies or documents, as needed.
    • Maintain the cleanliness and upkeep of the Embassy vehicles.
    • Adhere to all traffic laws and regulations at all times.
    • Professional appearance and discretion in performing duties.
    • Flexibility regarding the daily schedule and readiness for occasional travels outside Bucharest.
    • Assist with other duties around the Embassy as required.

Qualifications:

  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
  • Prior experience as a professional driver (at least 5 years of experience).
  • Knowledge of Bucharest roads and traffic patterns.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English.

Benefits of Working at the Embassy of Montenegro

  • Potential for career growth and development.
  • Supportive and collaborative work culture.
  • Employment contract in accordance with the applicable legal legal regulations of Romania, health insurance and contributions paid, holidays under Romanian and Montenegrin legislation.
